title: Phase IV, randomized, open-label, open-label, controlled, parallel, multicenter clinical trial in patients who are candidates for smoking cessation to evaluate the safety and efficacy of citisinicline maintenance therapy.
official: Phase IV, randomized, open-label, open-label, controlled, parallel, multicenter clinical trial in patients who are candidates for smoking cessation to evaluate the safety and efficacy of citisinicline maintenance therapy.
summary: Main objective: The general objective of this study is to evaluate the efficacy, safety and economic impact of two prolonged regimens of cytisinicline (50 and 75 days in duration) and Compare them with the usual regimen (25 days).

interventions.name: Recigarum 1,5 mg comprimidos recubiertos con película EFG

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Men and women of legal age who smoke more than 10 cigarettes a day during the last year and during the last month of the screening visit.
2. Be prepared and motivated to quit smoking (have a score on the visual analog motivation scale greater than or equal to 7).
3. Not having been on pharmacological treatment for nicotine dependence (nicotine replacement therapy [NRT], varenicline, bupropion or cytisinicline) during the last 3 months.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Kidney and/or liver failure.
2. Patients receiving treatment with antituberculosis drugs.
3. Patients receiving drugs metabolized by the CYP1A2 and CYP1A1 enzyme, especially those with a narrow therapeutic range (e.g., theophylline, tacrine, clozapine, and ropinirole).
4. Women treated with systemic hormonal contraceptives.
5. Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
6. Over 65 years of age (due to limited clinical experience).
7. Hypersensitivity to the active ingredient or to any of the excipients.
8. Unstable angina.
9. Recent personal history of acute myocardial infarction or recent stroke (less than 8 weeks).
10. Arrhythmias with clinical relevance or uncontrolled arterial hypertension.
11. History of psychiatric illness with and without treatment (panic disorder, psychosis, bipolar disorder, depression) in the last 12 months.
12. History of alcohol or other drug abuse in the last 12 months.
13. Use of tobacco products other than cigarettes, e-cigarettes, or marijuana in the past month and did not agree to abstain from using these products during study participation.
